dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the body width from the mid-dorsal section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle asymmetrical bulging on the mid-left lateral margin with a corresponding slight indentation on the mid-right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, localized grey patch situated on the mid-left lateral-dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient at the margins of the mid-left grey patch where it meets the white epidermal baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark focal spot located on the lower left posterior quadrant of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a small, distinct dark pigmented mark on the posterior left flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Faint longitudinal ridge or crease visible along the central dorsal midline.
